home.look.classic.name: Desktop
home.look.classic.sub: Icons and folders you arrange yourself.
home.look.glass.sub: Calm and clear. A big clock, meeting first, your people next, apps in a dock.
home.look.orbit.sub: You in the middle. Your people, rooms and apps circle around you.
home.look.pulse.sub: Bold and quick. Your people on top, big cards, tabs under your thumb.
home.pickNote: One Home Screen, different ways to look at it. Nothing is moved or lost when you switch.
home.pickFirstNote: Pick the look you like. Each one is drawn here from your own Home Screen. You can change it any time, and nothing is moved or lost.
home.pickFoot: Your choice follows you to your other devices. Looks are a try-out on this test build.
home.setNote: One Home Screen, different ways to look at it. Nothing is moved or lost when you switch. Looks are a try-out on this test build.
home.joinNote: Type any name. If the room is new, you start it. A room by name is majority-rules (aka open): anyone with the name can come in.
home.joinShort: A new name starts a room. Anyone with the name can come in.
home.honest: Calls go device to device, end-to-end encrypted. Your people and rooms are kept on this device.
home.myRoomSub: Your own address, if you choose to share it
home.myRoomStands: {room} · stands by with mic and camera off
home.hostSub: You hold the host password and decide who comes in
home.goLiveSub: Broadcast to as many viewers as come
home.addSomeoneSub: Cards, ringing and missed calls are in Rooms
home.addPeopleSub: Swap cards in a meeting, then call with one tap
home.noPeople: Nobody here yet. In any meeting, open someone’s tile and choose Our private room: after that you call each other with one tap.
home.noRooms: Rooms you join show up here.
home.orbitHint: Tap a face to call. Tap yourself to meet.
home.locked: Locked. Open the app to see it.
home.widgetsNote: A widget is a small view of one of your apps. Put any widget in any place it fits, in the order you like.
home.widgetsFoot: Widgets come from the apps on your Home Screen. Add an app that has widgets and they show up here. Your layout follows you to your other devices.
home.widgetsReset: Put this look back as it came
home.slotEmpty: Nothing here. Add a widget below.
